name: Farrowing
flow: tap a miscarriage / not in pig / removed row
Save, or Back, when opened from Finish
Save, or Back, when opened from the locked record
Save, when opened from the blocked Finish
Save, or Back, on a sow that died
End task early (sows still farrowing or unsaved)
tap the still-farrowing warning, then a sow
tap the will-be-removed warning, then a sow
tap an outcome, then a miscarriage sow
tap Sow deaths, then a sow
Show N sows, Reset or Back
Piglet records, then Add piglet or a piglet row
Piglet records, tick piglets, Report mortality

notes.purpose: The task's home: pick the next sow in one unit, read the unit's litter size and the whole task's progress, and jump by pen, ear tag or search.
states: Empty list: "No awaiting sows" / "No matching sows" with a hint ("Adjust the filters…" when a filter is on, else "Choose another status…")
Task already ended: the room is replaced by the Today card "Task ended · N finished / View receipt"
Unit switched from the Task overview: scroll position and current pen are kept per unit, and reset when the lens or filter changed meanwhile

elements.name: Sow row
elements.shows: One line per task sow, grouped under her pen: ear tag, state chip, two text lines, rail icon.

states.when: No live total (alive + dead = 0), not finished, no outcome. Due text begins "Due tomorrow" or "Due in N days"
states.shows: No chip. Line 1 "Due tomorrow" / "Due in 2 days" (muted). Line 2 "parity 5 · 11 born last" (12 when unknown). Chevron.

states.when: Same, due text "Due today" or "Due yesterday"
states.shows: Line 1 "Due today" in ink (not muted). Line 2 as above. Chevron.

states.when: Due text begins "Overdue" (expected date = service + 114 days; overdue from day 116)
states.shows: Line 1 "Overdue · 3 days": only "3 days" is red, the word stays ink. Line 2 as above.

states.when: Live total above zero and not finished
states.shows: Green "Active" chip. Line 1 "9 alive · 5 dead". Line 2 "born 14 · 1h ago · G.H" ("just now" after a tap in this session). Chevron. No overdue colour once she has a record.
Grey "Done" chip. Line 1 alive · dead as now (alive falls when later deaths are recorded). Line 2 "born 14 · final 05:58 · G.H". Pencil icon: locked but editable.

states.when: Farrowing ended through the sow's death
states.shows: Red "Sow died" chip instead of Done. Same two lines; line 2 "born 10 · yesterday · L.M". Pencil. Counts under the Done tab.

states.when: Miscarriage, Not in pig or Removed from batch recorded
states.shows: No chip. Line 1 the outcome name; line 2 "Recorded · 08:10 · G.H". Chevron; opens the Production log. Counts under Done.

elements.logic: Days are counted from due, never the gestation day. Awaiting vs Active flips on the live total: a sow counted back to zero reads Awaiting again and regains her Due line. Recency ("1h ago") and hand ("G.H") are fixed sample text, not computed from records.

elements.name: Unit card
elements.shows: The left half of the context strip: unit name, one large figure, its label and a target line.

states.when: The figure is below the target (the card's belowTarget flag)
states.shows: "Target 12" in amber text

states.when: The figure meets or beats the target
states.shows: "Target 12" in the normal support colour

elements.rule: Confirmed by the owner: Target is an amber below-target warning. It is amber when the unit's live-per-litter is below the target and neutral otherwise.
elements.logic: Figure = the unit's average live piglets per litter ("Live / litter"); target = its per-litter target. Not editable; the unit changes only through the Task overview or Home's Choose unit.

elements.name: Task overview card
elements.shows: The right half of the strip, one button that opens the Task overview: heading, number, label, three-colour bar, support line.

states.shows: "7 / 18 · Farrowed · all units" with support "2 active · 9 awaiting"
That segment is left out of the bar; the number and support text still print the zero

states.when: Sows with miscarriage, not in pig or removed, or that died before or during farrowing
states.shows: Counted in neither the number nor the denominator, so they leave the bar entirely

elements.logic: Numerator Farrowed = finished litters in all units, excluding outcomes and sows that died before or during farrowing (a sow that died after finishing stays counted). Denominator = Farrowed + Active + Awaiting. Segment widths are proportional to those counts. Scope is all units and never follows the lens or filter.

elements.name: Last record line
elements.shows: "Last record 08:41 · G. Hansen" under the app bar.
elements.logic: Meant to be the newest record time and hand in the unit. In the prototype it is fixed text: 08:41, or 09:41 once any sow carries the 09:41 stamp a live tap writes; the hand is always G. Hansen.

elements.name: State tabs
elements.shows: Awaiting · Active · Done · All, each with a count; All is the default.

states.shows: Counts for the whole current unit, e.g. Awaiting 4 · Active 1 · Done 2 · All 7

states.when: Due or parity filter is on
states.shows: Every count shrinks to the filtered sows
Tab stays, shows 0; the list shows the empty state

elements.logic: Counts are for the current unit only (not all units) and follow the filter, not the other tab. Done = finished litters, sows that died and sows with a recorded outcome. Selecting a tab resets the scroll to the top.

elements.name: Filter
elements.shows: Funnel button beside the tabs; opens the Filter sows sheet (due range, parity).

states.when: Due range 7+ days ago … in 7+ days and parity Any
states.shows: Plain funnel, no summary line
Count badge on the funnel (0–2 filters) and a line under the tabs "Due: Today – In 2 days · Parity 2–5" with Clear

elements.rule: Apply keeps the filter until Clear; Clear removes both filters at once. The due range matches each sow's stored due text, so it also hides Active and Done sows by a date that no longer matters to them.

elements.name: Pen header
elements.shows: Pen code, sow count, chevron (opens the pen sheet), and "N shown" when rows are hidden.

states.when: Lens All and no filter, or every sow in the pen passes
states.shows: "B4 · 3 sows" ("1 sow" for one)

states.when: The lens or filter hides some of the pen's sows
states.shows: Count unchanged plus "2 shown" beside it

states.when: No sow of the pen passes
states.shows: Pen is not listed at all

elements.logic: The sow count is the pen's full task total, ignoring lens and filter. Pens are ordered alphanumerically.

elements.name: Dock
elements.shows: Go to pen (left), Scan ear tag (primary), Search (icon only).

states.shows: Shows the pen at the top of the list under the sticky bar; follows scroll live and updates after a jump or after opening a sow. "Pens" when none.

states.when: Each A–D × 1–6 pen in the Go to pen sheet
states.shows: One-word fact: "Active" / "2 active"; else "Overdue" / "2 overdue"; else "N born ✓" when all finished; else "Due today" or the first due text; "No matches" (pen has sows, none pass the view, disabled); "Not in task" (disabled)

elements.rule: Pen map: tap jumps to the pen and highlights it for 0.9 s; hold 0.35 s peeks at its sows. The tab bar and filter line stay stuck at the top while the list scrolls. Scan ear tag has no camera in the prototype ("Try sample tag" opens the first sow) and also holds the ear-tag text search.
elements.source: farrowing-astra-concept.js room() dock, penFact(), roomAfterRender(), scroll handler

controls.does: opens a Pen sheet (not a separate screen): notices, Feed guidance, Report equipment fault, Add/Edit pen note, Pen log
opens "Find a sow": ear tag or pen text with live "N sows found"; a result opens like a row

copy: (raw) Task overview · 7 / 18 · Farrowed · all units · 2 active · 9 awaiting
(raw) Due today · Due tomorrow · Due in N days · Due yesterday · Overdue · N days
(raw) Go to pen · Scan ear tag · Search ear tag
(raw) No awaiting sows · No matching sows
edge: A sow with an unsaved Edit draft blocks ending the task, but her row shows nothing about the draft
Done tab can exceed Farrowed on the card (Done 8 across units vs Farrowed 7) because Done includes sow deaths and outcome rows
Filter that hides every sow: empty state with the filter hint; Clear or Reset recovers
rules: "Rows speak in days from due, never gestation day" (Model)
"Every litter row carries its three numbers … alive · dead on line 1, born on line 2" (Model)
"No staleness tracking on Active sows" / interval chip retired (Model)
"The overdue signal ends at the first record" (Model)
"She stays in the room" with a red sow-died chip (Starting and ending a session)
"Identity is sheet-first … the room row offers no sow-page target" (Surfaces & entrances)
"Color lives on the value, the word stays ink" (Model)
"Dates speak relative within the week" (Names and glyphs; copy pass)
"words carry actions, icons carry objects" — the dock's Scan ear tag is the one sanctioned icon + text pairing (Names and glyphs)
issues: Unit card and tabs are Unit 7 only; the Task overview card is all units. Only the card names its scope.
Active and Awaiting appear three times at two scopes: bar segments, support text and tabs.
"Done 2" and "Farrowed 7" look like one measure but count differently; neither label explains it.
Prototype hard-codes amber (belowTarget = true); never shows the neutral state.
Row recency and hand are hard-coded; "1h ago" never ticks. Overdue rows lack the ruled "induced yesterday · L.M" second line.
Last record line repeats each row's recency; the ruled one-sentence task copy under it is missing.
Pen headers open pen tools (feed, fault, note, log) although the rulings call them census-only dead zones; unclear whose feature that is.
Two search doors: the magnifier and the text search inside Scan ear tag.
Entry mismatch: Home's whole-farm card is meant to land here but opens the Task overview sheet over it first.

notes.purpose: Keep the live count while she farrows: one big Alive number whose + and − save at once, with the litter so far.
states: Death draft waiting (kept with Back): Finish farrowing shows its waiting look and takes the worker back to the Record dead draft; no blocked sheet (owner decision 2026-10-10)
Visit with nothing changed: receipt reads just "Saved"

elements.name: Alive stepper
elements.shows: Large − and + keys around the Alive number (not typeable).

states.when: Alive is more than anchor − dead recorded
states.shows: − and + both live; each tap changes Alive and the open visit and is saved at once
− is greyed (aria-disabled); a tap writes nothing and shows the pointer text for 4 s in place of the receipt
Number is grey; she reads as Before first count

elements.logic: Alive = posted + this visit. + is always allowed; the first + makes an Awaiting sow Active. Recording a death lowers the floor, so − becomes possible again. Counting down to zero makes her Awaiting again.

elements.name: Receipt
elements.shows: Status line under the number.

states.shows: "Saved"
"Saved · +4 this visit"
"Saved · 2 died this visit"

states.when: A greyed − was tapped, for 4 s
states.shows: "Use Record dead for deaths. Use Edit for corrections."

elements.logic: The visit folds into one log line ("+4 alive") when the sheet is left by any exit.

elements.name: Litter summary
elements.shows: Born and Dead figures, the causes line and View log.

states.shows: One chip per type with a non-zero count: Stillborn 1 · Mummified 1 · Crushed 2 · Other 1
Causes line is hidden

states.when: Nothing recorded and no pending count
states.shows: View log is disabled

elements.logic: Born = Alive + all dead (derived, never typed). Dead = sum of the six types.

elements.name: Edit · Record death
elements.shows: Two of the three quick actions (the third is More actions).

states.when: Nothing posted: no events and Born is 0
states.shows: Greyed
"N unsaved" in small text under the label while a draft is open (Back keeps the draft, and a reload keeps it for the session)

elements.name: Finish farrowing
elements.shows: Primary button in the bar.

states.shows: Greyed

Opens the Finish sheet. While piglet deaths are drafted the button is in its waiting look and tapping it opens the Record dead sheet with the draft, so the deaths are saved first (owner decision 2026-10-10)

controls.does: each tap is saved at once; − at the floor is refused with the pointer text

copy: (raw) Use Record dead for deaths. Use Edit for corrections.
edge: Leaving by any exit folds the visit; reopening shows the folded total
An Edit draft kept with Back is not lost; Finish then opens blocked
rules: "Born = Alive + Σ Dead … Derived, never entered" (Model)
"The Born floor … + is free; − drains pending and clamps at the floor" (Model)
"The hero numeral is plain … the keys own the input" (Model)
"Type-to-set is retired on count figures" (Surfaces & entrances)
"The hero owns the total; the receipt owns the change" — "Saved · +4 this visit" (Model)
"Farrowing starts at the first recorded event — full stop" (Starting and ending a session)
"The exit word is always Back" (Piglet processing, Round 5)
issues: Four exits for one sheet (X, Back, handle, backdrop); the rulings keep the handle, backdrop and a bar exit but no close button.
Born and Dead repeat on Finish, the locked record and the log.
Header lacks the ruled recency stamp and day count; its status word "Farrowing" repeats the room chip.
Pointer text differs from the ruled two-pointer copy and replaces the receipt, so the layout moves; "Record death" should read "Record dead".
Minus at the floor is only aria-disabled; whether it looks disabled depends on CSS.

notes.purpose: The counting sheet for a sow with nothing recorded yet: Alive 0, Record death live (a stillborn can be the first record).
states: Counted back to zero later: reads this state again, but View log and Edit stay available if events exist

elements.name: Header state line
elements.shows: The status word after the pen and parity.

states.when: No live total, expected date ahead or today
states.shows: "Due today" / "Due tomorrow" / "Due in 2 days" (the room's Due line without the day number)
"Overdue · 3 days"

states.when: After the first + or first death
states.shows: "Farrowing", on the same sheet

elements.name: Alive and receipt
elements.shows: Grey 0, then the line "Tap + as piglets are born".
elements.logic: − is greyed, + is live. The receipt line shows only while there are no events and Alive is 0; the first tap turns it into "Saved · +1 this visit". Opening and leaving without a tap writes nothing.
elements.rule: The first + (or first death) is the start of farrowing; there is no separate start action.

elements.name: Unavailable controls
elements.shows: What is greyed while nothing is recorded.

states.shows: Disabled
Disabled
Disabled
Live: a stillborn can be the first record

controls.does: first record: she becomes Farrowing on this same sheet and the room row crosses to Active when she is left
opens the death drawer; a stillborn can be the first record

edge: A stray + that nobody undoes hides an overdue sow behind "1 alive · 0 dead" (accepted cost in the rulings)
A sow recounted to zero is not a virgin sheet: History and Edit stay reachable
rules: "Farrowing starts at the first recorded event — full stop. The started mark is KILLED" (Starting and ending a session)
"registers derive from the live total (posted + open pending)" (Starting and ending a session)
"A non-empty ledger is never unreachable" (Starting and ending a session)
"The pre-start face stays bare — no records yet" (Surfaces & entrances)
issues: Receipt copy "Tap + as piglets are born" is the instruction the ruling removed; it belongs under the room title, where it is missing too.
Edit and Finish are drawn dimmed; the rulings allow dim-as-disabled only for the Alive minus floor.
The ruled gestation day is missing from the header; it repeats the Due line the room row just showed.

notes.purpose: The one dead drawer: tally piglets born dead or died by type, or record the sow's own death.
states: Photo dialog over the drawer (tap a thumbnail): Back, Delete
Opened from Before first count, Finish, the locked record or the ended record: same drawer, returns to where it was opened

elements.name: Dead header
elements.shows: "Dead 6" with "Born dead or died · 1 unsaved" and Clear.

states.shows: "Dead 5" (saved total); no unsaved count; Clear left out; Save disabled
"Dead 6" (saved + draft); "1 unsaved" in muted ink; Clear live

elements.name: Type rows
elements.shows: Stillborn · Mummified · Crushed · Scours · Starve-out · Other, each with − n +.

states.shows: + has no limit; deaths raise Born, never Alive
+ stops when drafted deaths equal Alive now; saving lowers Alive now

elements.logic: Value = saved total + this draft (draft in green). − only undoes the draft and is disabled at 0 draft.

elements.name: Piglets | The sow
elements.shows: Two-way segment at the top.

states.shows: Piglets and The sow
The sow segment is not offered

elements.name: The sow
elements.shows: Radio causes Farrowing · Prolapse · Found dead · Other, a red band and a hold-to-save bar.

states.shows: Save disabled

states.when: A piglet draft or an Edit draft exists
states.shows: Band adds "Save or clear the pending piglet deaths / correction before ending" with Review; Save disabled
Save enabled; "Other" adds an optional details line

elements.rule: Saving is a 0.85 s hold: ends farrowing, freezes Born, writes "Sow died · cause". Band always reads "Saving ends farrowing · 7 alive stay under piglet care" (current Alive).

elements.name: Photos
elements.shows: Optional photos with a camera button and thumbnails.
elements.logic: Camera is disabled until a death is drafted (or a sow cause is chosen). Photos ride the save.

elements.name: Save and Back
elements.shows: Bar.
elements.rule: Save (piglets) adds the draft to the dead types and writes one log line such as "+3 crushed · +1 other". Back keeps the draft; only Clear discards it (and any sow cause); the ruling says they should keep it.

controls.does: commits the deaths and returns to the screen it was opened from
goes back to Piglets mode or to Edit to resolve the draft

copy: (raw) Dead N · Born dead or died · N unsaved
(raw) Stillborn · Mummified · Crushed · Scours · Starve-out · Other
(raw) Saving ends farrowing · N alive stay under piglet care
edge: Sow cannot be saved dead twice: sow mode disappears once ended
A piglet draft or an Edit draft blocks saving the sow's death

notes.purpose: Report weak and deformed piglets, add optional facts, then hold to finish and lock Born.

elements.name: Piglet condition
elements.shows: Weak and Deformed steppers: "Among the 9 alive piglets · 0 if none".
elements.rule: Each tap saves at once. Weak + deformed cannot exceed Alive (the + greys out). Healthy has no row; it is Alive − weak − deformed and prints on the record.

elements.name: Optional facts
elements.shows: Two buttons, + Litter weight and + Assistance, each expanding a field.

states.shows: Button label only
Label carries the answer: "Litter weight · 12.6 kg", "Assistance · Yes"
Assistance returns to "Not recorded"

elements.logic: Litter weight is a decimal number; a negative value is cleared. No range warning in the prototype (the ruled soft warning outside 0.8–2.5 kg × alive is absent).

elements.name: Finish farrowing (hold)
elements.shows: Primary button, caption HOLD TO FINISH.

states.when: Born above zero and no draft waiting
states.shows: Hold 0.85 s

states.when: Born is 0, or any draft waits
states.shows: Greyed; the sheet becomes Lock blocked when a draft waits

elements.rule: Hold 0.85 s locks Born (frozen = Born) and writes "Farrowing finished · born 14". Releasing early cancels without writing.

controls.does: locks the litter and opens the locked record

copy: (raw) Piglet condition · Among the N alive piglets · 0 if none
(raw) Assisted farrowing · No · Yes · Clear answer
edge: Born cannot be 0 when finishing
rules: "`Finish` is `Finish farrowing`" and "the Finish sheet's hold-to-lock stays the second guard" (Surfaces & entrances)
"Classification (weak/deformed) happens at Finish, commits per tap … Healthy has no form row" (Model)
"Optional facts at Finish: litter weight (soft range warn) + assisted checkbox, presented as one cohesive group" (Model)
"Lock born N is hold-to-commit" (Surfaces & entrances)
issues: The ruled button "Lock born N" reads "Finish farrowing", the same words as the sheet title.
The Born / Alive / Dead panel repeats the Counting summary one tap earlier.
Litter weight and Assistance are two collapsed buttons, not one cohesive group; X and Back both return to Counting.

screens.name: Leave edit with changes
screens.zh: 离开修改页（有未保存的修改）

notes.purpose: Back from Edit record with unsaved changes asks whether to save, so an unsaved correction can never reach Finish.
states: Dialog over the Edit record sheet: Save correction? with Discard and Save
copy: (raw) Save correction? · You changed this record. · Discard · Save
edge: The same ask appears on the grabber and Escape

notes.purpose: Read the finished litter: the frozen Born and every fact captured at finish.

elements.name: Header stamp
elements.shows: "Finished Aug 27 at 08:12 by G. Hansen" in place of the status word.
elements.logic: Date, time and hand come from the "Farrowing finished" event. This is the only place the finish date appears.

elements.name: Facts list
elements.shows: Born · Alive now · Dead · Weak · Deformed · Assisted · Litter weight.

states.shows: Born 14 · Alive now 8 · Dead 6 · Weak 1 · Deformed 1 · Assisted Yes · Litter weight 12.6 kg
Assisted "Not recorded"; Litter weight a dash
"Dead" shows 0 and is not a link

states.when: Piglet deaths recorded after the lock
states.shows: Alive now falls; Born never moves except through Correct born

elements.logic: Born is frozen at finish. Alive now = Born − dead recorded. Dead = all dead types; with Dead above zero it is a link to a Death breakdown sheet (each type with a count and Total dead).

copy: (raw) Born · Alive now · Dead · Weak · Deformed · Assisted · Litter weight
edge: Post-lock events never reopen farrowing
A missing piglet after the lock has no door here; it routes through the litter census elsewhere

notes.purpose: Correct posted figures while she is still farrowing: Alive and each dead type in place, logged as one stamped correction.

elements.name: Corrected rows
elements.shows: No banner. Back with changes asks "Save correction?" (Save / Discard).

states.shows: No banner; Clear left out; Save correction disabled
No banner: a changed row shows its new value in ink with a muted "was 2" beside the label; Save correction enabled. Who and old → new go to the log after saving.

elements.name: Figure rows
elements.shows: Alive and the six dead types, each − n +.
elements.logic: Editable in place, floor 0, amber when different from posted. No Born row (Born derives). Alive can go below the counting floor here; nothing on the screen explains it.

elements.name: Save and Back
elements.shows: Bar.
elements.rule: Save commits everything as one stamped correction event, folds the open visit and re-anchors the floor. Back keeps the draft: Counting shows it as pending and Finish is then blocked.

controls.does: commits the correction and returns (to Finish when opened from it)

edge: A missed fact is a recording, never an Edit
rules: "ONE correction door: Edit, always available in the During bar — and it is ONE SCREEN" (Surfaces & entrances)

notes.purpose: After farrowing has finished, someone finds Born was wrong: a popup adds born piglets or sets the total again.

elements.name: Correction mode
elements.shows: Radios More born / Count was wrong with a stepper.

states.shows: Stepper "+1", minimum 1; adds a signed delta
Stepper shows the new Born (starts at the current 14); minimum = dead recorded, so it cannot go below the bodies

elements.logic: Switching mode resets the number (1, or the current Born).

elements.name: Alive | Died
elements.shows: Chips for where the extra piglets go.

states.shows: Extra piglets are added alive
Cause list of the six types appears (Other preselected) and the piglets add to that dead type

elements.name: Apply
elements.shows: Back · Apply.

notes.purpose: Read-only list of everything recorded for this litter, grouped by day.

elements.name: Log title

Title "Production log"; subtitle names the outcome

notes.purpose: The record of a litter whose sow died: a red band with the cause and the litter facts as they stood.

elements.name: Header stamp and band
elements.shows: "Died Aug 25 at 06:20 by L. Madsen" and a red band "Sow died · prolapse".
elements.logic: Stamp from the Sow died event; the band carries the chosen cause (Other prints its details). The death is thus told in the stamp, the band and the room chip.

elements.name: Litter summary
elements.shows: Born 10 · Alive 7 · Dead 3 with a causes line.

elements.rule: Enabled as soon as any one of tag, notch, sex or weight has a value. A new identity moves one piglet from "Without identity" to "Identified" and writes "Piglet identity added · tag" to the sow's history; the list then shows the Piglet records tab.
elements.logic: Scan tag and Ear notch on the Piglet records tab open this form pre-filled with a sample tag (418001 plus the number identified) or a "Choose notch" placeholder.

edge: Dead piglets stay in the list but cannot be selected.
issues: Save accepts sex or weight alone, so a row can be saved with neither tag nor notch; RULINGS (Piglet processing, Q3) says tag or notch identifies and sex and weight are optional.

notes.purpose: Record piglet deaths in one pass: the identified piglets ticked on the Piglet records tab, plus any without identity.

elements.name: Unidentified piglets
elements.shows: A stepper, shown only while the litter has piglets without identity.
elements.logic: Maximum = the smaller of piglets without identity and alive piglets minus those already ticked. Total to report = ticked piglets + this stepper.

elements.name: Cause
elements.shows: A picker: Cause unknown, Crushed, Scours, Starve-out, Other.
elements.logic: One cause applies to the whole save ("Use another pass when the causes differ"). The litter's counters have six types: Cause unknown is counted under Other, and Stillborn and Mummified are not offered here.

elements.name: Save mortality
elements.shows: Primary action, "Save mortality · 3".
elements.rule: Disabled until a cause is chosen and the total is above zero. Saving marks the ticked piglets Dead, lowers Alive by the total, adds the total to that cause's dead counter, never lowers Born, and writes "N piglets died · cause" (with any photos) to the history.

edge: Reachable with nothing ticked when the litter has piglets without identity ("0 identified selected"); Save stays disabled until the stepper or a tick gives a total.
issues: A third place to record piglet deaths in the same prototype: the sow's Record dead drawer (staged, with Stillborn and Mummified), the Record piglet deaths row on More actions, and this form. RULINGS says "ONE dead drawer product-wide".
